excerpt: AI Won’t Take Your Job — But People Who Use AI Will Move Ahead Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. AI isn’t just transforming offices — it’s officially transforming creative industries too. Last week, Forbes published an article on their LinkedIn page titled “AI Is In The Office—And The Recording Studio”, highlighting how AI-generated songs are now entering the Billboard charts. And that shift says everything about the future of work. In the past four weeks alone, an AI-created song has debuted on a Billboard chart every single week.
